encodings.reduced: selector a = the pair's first qubit, data d = its second; reduced two-label LCU with CNOT as H CZ H on d; CZ depth n repeats CZ(a, d) (n - 1) times after the SELECT CZ, each after a per-qubit barrier run
encodings.walk: control c on q11, data bits on the layout's data qubits in ascending bit order; CNOT as H CZ H on the data qubit; omega as Z on c after its first H
encodings.readout: readout-0 measures all 17 qubits in |0>, readout-1 after X on all 17

preregistered.observable: zero-product success; classification statistic D = Pc(+, -) - Pc(+, +) per row from its two replicas on one pair, the y_sign -1 replica minus the y_sign +1 replica
preregistered.rows: opposite-sign edge (1,10)(4,15) of kite 3 on (1, 4), its census twist the same-sign edge (4,10)(1,15) of kite 6 on (10, 13), strut (1,10)(2,9) of kite 3 on (12, 14); batch-00 holds the edge at y_sign +1, the twist at -1 and the strut at +1, batch-01 the opposite signs
preregistered.predictions: D = -1 opposite edge, +1 twist (same-sign edge), 0 strut; P(edge, y) = P(twist, -y) under the twist map (L, U, x; L', U', y) -> (L', U, x; L, U', -y)
preregistered.classification: D above +0.4 same-sign, below -0.4 opposite-sign, |D| below 0.2 strut, otherwise unresolved; predicted |D| on edges at least 0.72 (pessimistic)
preregistered.falsifier: a row misclassified or unresolved refutes the separation estimate for its pair; a strut with |D| > 0.1 + 3 sigma exposes a pair-dependent bias the analysis carries; a twist pair whose Pc differ by more than 3 combined standard errors plus the pair-location allowance (the difference of the two pairs' depth-1 bright Pc in T0) refutes twist equality for that layout
preregistered.stop_rule: each batch: every job completed with the manifest's shots; readout-0 P1 at most 0.10 and readout-1 P1 at least 0.80 on every used qubit (a failure stops the series and re-plans the layout); every bright or reference replica at raw P(selector = 0) at least 0.7; every qubit the witness leaves idle at P1 at most 0.15 above its readout-0 P1 (bit-order conformance); circuit digests equal cases.json; the account's queue empty; a 120 s pause before the next batch
